description: Fetch one ad from the HADS pool for a site key, to show under an answer, in a terminal or on a page. Showing it counts as an impression for that site. Use format=text for one line to append to a chat answer, ansi for a terminal, json for the fields. Always label it as an ad when you show it.

site_key.description: The site key (site_…) of the surface that shows the ad

topic.description: A topic slug hint, e.g. programming (see hads_topics)

name: hads_serve_ad
title: Get an ad to show
